summary:
Comprehensive responsive audit across all 14 routes at 390px (mobile) and 768px (tablet). Initial pass detected horizontal overflow (~22px on mobile, ~29px on tablet) on EVERY page — root-caused to Footer.jsx: (1) copyright

had whitespace-nowrap forcing overflow at mobile, (2) unbreakable email string 'info@xophthalmics.com' overflowed narrow contact column at md, (3) gap-14 too wide for md breakpoint. Applied 3 surgical Footer fixes; re-ran full sweep: 28/28 checks pass with no horizontal overflow. Verified previously-fixed areas render correctly: Exam '19' watermark absent on mobile, System step numbers scale correctly, Fit tabs wrap to 3 rows on mobile, SectionAnchors absent/hidden on all mobile & tablet views, CookiePolicy shows stacked cards on mobile (no table), Contact form stacks single column. No other visible responsive breaks found on any of the 14 pages at either breakpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx bottom-row copyright had whitespace-nowrap that caused a site-wide 22px horizontal overflow at 390px (affected all 14 pages). Removed.

Footer.jsx contact email 'info@xophthalmics.com' had no word-break allowance; at md breakpoint (768px) with 12-col grid + gap-14 the contact column was too narrow to fit the string, causing ~29px overflow on ALL pages. Added min-w-0 + break-all on the anchor and min-w-0 on its flex parent.
Footer.jsx grid used gap-14 (56px) even at md breakpoint, which is too wide for 768px viewport with 12 columns; reduced to md:gap-8 (32px) with lg:gap-14 restored for larger screens.

Recommendation: consider adding a global CSS guard like `html, body { overflow-x: clip }` (or Tailwind's overflow-x-hidden on <body>) as a safety net for future decorative absolute-positioned elements that may accidentally overflow the viewport (found in Home.jsx's `-right-16` blurred blob, and marquees — currently these are properly contained but a global guard would prevent future regressions).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (28/28 route+breakpoint combos pass overflow check post-fix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive audit complete. Footer fixes resolved a site-wide overflow issue affecting all 14 pages at both mobile (390px) and tablet (768px) breakpoints. Previously-called-out fixes (Exam 19 watermark, System step numbers, Fit tabs wrap, Iris accordion, Contact form, CookiePolicy stacked cards, SectionAnchors hidden below lg) all verified working on mobile.
rca of the issue:
Initial finding: scrollWidth=412 on every mobile page (390px viewport → 22px overflow) and scrollWidth=797 on every tablet page (768 → 29px overflow). Isolated by iterating `body *` for elements whose scrollWidth exceeded clientWidth. Discovered the offender was inside the shared Footer component — a `whitespace-nowrap` copyright paragraph (388px content in 342px container) and an unbreakable email link (171px anchor in ~130px column). Fix: removed whitespace-nowrap on

, added min-w-0 + break-all on the email anchor and its flex parent, and reduced md-only gap from gap-14 to md:gap-8 while retaining lg:gap-14. Post-fix: all 14 routes × 2 breakpoints = 28 checks pass with scrollWidth === clientWidth.
